recognize_zh: 8 週後的低倍血液抹片中，大片紅血球間只剩零星白血球，箭頭指向一顆單核球與一顆小淋巴球，看不到先前大量藍色細胞質的芽細胞；白血球數量明顯下降、芽細胞消失，代表 TAM 已自行緩解。
features: Low-power peripheral blood smear with markedly fewer nucleated cells than at presentation
Scattered small round lymphocytes with dense nuclei
Arrows indicate a monocyte (larger, irregular) and an adjacent lymphocyte
No clusters of basophilic blast-like cells identified at this magnification
Evenly distributed normocytic red cells; cellular detail limited by low power
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows a reduced number of leukocytes compared with the presentation smear, consisting of scattered lymphocytes and monocytes (arrows indicate a monocyte and a lymphocyte). No blasts are identified in this field, although cytologic detail is limited at this power and confirmation on high power and by flow cytometry is appropriate. Red cells are evenly distributed. Findings are consistent with spontaneous resolution of transient abnormal myelopoiesis at 8 weeks.

ddx.dx: Persistent TAM or early myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Would show continued circulating blasts with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm or cytopenias, not seen at this power but requiring high-power and flow confirmation.
Reduced counts with neutropenia and thrombocytopenia would suggest marrow failure or evolving ML-DS rather than simple regression; correlate with the CBC.
